svg.title: paceline in a Claude Code window
svg.desc: A Claude Code window with paceline's status line under the prompt, playing 8 scenes in a loop: Fresh day, Working through the day, Over budget, Session running low, Cache went cold, Agent job, Several windows, and Last day. Today's bar drains as its budget is spent, and the week counts up from 0 of 100.

text.tspan: Each morning, today's budget is set from what's left in the week, and its bar starts full.
Found it. The date picker formats in UTC. Switching it to the user's timezone now.
> also check the invoice dates while you're in there
As you work, today's bar drains, and its numbers turn yellow, then red, as the budget runs low.
Offline sync is in. Moving the queue logic into its own module next.
> go ahead and do the conflict handling too
Past today's budget, red cells count the overage, and tomorrow's smaller budget follows.
Webhook retries now back off properly. Adding a test for the duplicate event case.
> log the event id when a duplicate is skipped
With the session segment on, a low session shows when it resets, and a filling context gets a warning.
The flaky test is a race in the session refresh. Tracing where the token gets swapped.
> add a regression test for the token refresh once it's fixed
After a long pause the prompt cache expires, so it warns that the next message costs about twice as much.
The docs build is green. Let me know what to tackle next.
> add a search box to the docs sidebar
An agent working through a batch reports its progress, one cell per step, until the job is done.
> work through the open issues on the board
#327 passed review. Committing, then picking up #328.
bypass permissions on (shift+tab to cycle) · /tasks to see subagents · ← 4 agents
#328 passed review. Committing, then picking up #329.
bypass permissions on (shift+tab to cycle) · /tasks to see subagents · ← 4 agents
#329 passed review. Committing, then picking up #330.
bypass permissions on (shift+tab to cycle) · /tasks to see subagents · ← 3 agents
All five issues are done and committed.
Every window shares the same limits, and each one shows its own project in its own color.
On the last day before the weekly reset, today's budget is everything left in the week.
Copy tweaks are done across all six screens.
> make the empty states match the new illustrations
